quizzes.question: Add an element to the end of an array.
quizzes.explanation: push adds an element to the end of an array.

quizzes.question: Remove the last element of an array.
quizzes.explanation: pop removes and returns the last element of an array.

quizzes.question: Iterate over an array.
quizzes.explanation: forEach executes a function on each element of an array.

quizzes.question: Transform an array.
quizzes.explanation: map returns a new array with each element transformed.

quizzes.question: Filter an array.
quizzes.explanation: filter returns an array of elements that satisfy the condition.

quizzes.question: Reduce an array to a single value.
quizzes.code: const sum = arr.____((a, b) => a + b, 0);
quizzes.explanation: reduce accumulates array elements into a single value.

quizzes.question: Find an element.
quizzes.explanation: find returns the first element that satisfies the condition.

quizzes.question: Check if all elements satisfy a condition.
quizzes.explanation: every returns true if all elements satisfy the condition.

quizzes.question: Sort an array.
quizzes.explanation: sort sorts an array. A comparison function is needed.

quizzes.question: Check if an array contains an element.
quizzes.explanation: includes returns true if the element is in the array.
